items.title: Jensen Huang Is Back. Nvidia’s (NVDA) Bull Case Remains
items.summary: Jensen Huang is back at the helm, and Nvidia’s (NVDA) bull case remains in play. Nvidia shares surged 31.5% on November 23 after news of Jensen Huang’s reinstatement, underscoring how closely investor confidence in the company is tied to its co-founder. While near-term volatility is likely to persist, I remain decisively Bullish over the long term.
